domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers product identification, advanced cooking methods, kitchen design, equipment utilization, food fabrication, plate presentation, and recipe development for professional culinary environments to ensure candidates demonstrate high level technical proficiency in their daily kitchen operations.

This domain focuses on safe food and product handling procedures, local laws and regulations, and strict HACCP compliance standards to ensure operational safety and sanitation within a professional kitchen environment at all times for all staff.

This domain examines professional baking methods, technical pastry skills, precise formulas, equipment, quality ingredients, and artistic presentation standards required of executive pastry leaders to maintain high quality output in a professional setting for all guests.

This domain addresses food allergies, dietary considerations, nutritional guidelines, and healthy menu planning principles needed to accommodate diverse modern customer nutritional requirements while maintaining the integrity of the culinary experience for all guests in the dining room.

This domain includes budget development, reading financial statements, purchasing strategies, receiving procedures, operational policies, menu design, and marketing techniques for profitable restaurant management and effective oversight of kitchen financial performance and operational success for the entire business.

This domain covers effective personnel management, team development strategies, federal employment laws, labor regulations, professional ethics, and talent recruitment practices for executive kitchen leaders to foster a productive and legally compliant work environment for their culinary staff.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Bring a photo identification, a pen, scratch paper, and a basic calculator. Check cell phones completely off and ensure a stable internet connection if taking the exam through the online learning center to avoid any technical interruptions.

faq.answer_text: The written exam consists of exactly 100 multiple-choice questions administered through the online learning center. Candidates are given a total of 90 minutes to complete all items during the session.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The official passing score is determined using a modified Angoff Technique to ensure fairness. Candidates must meet the required threshold to pass the written certification examination successfully.
Candidates have 90 minutes to complete the 100 question multiple-choice written exam. This time limit is strictly enforced for all candidates taking the certification test online.

Please check with American Culinary Federation (ACF) for the current certification path and associated fees. Costs may vary based on membership status and specific exam requirements for each candidate.
faq.question_title: What is the cost of certification?

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the American Culinary Federation Certified Executive Chef exam. Review the 100 question format, 90 minute duration, and the six core competency.

methodology.summary: This index page was constructed using official candidate handbooks, official exam guides, and detailed content outlines provided directly by the American Culinary Federation to ensure accuracy for all candidates.

editorial.overview: The American Culinary Federation Certified Executive Chef examination measures advanced knowledge, technical capability, and practical leadership skills required for professional culinarians. Certified and administered by the American Culinary Federation, candidates are evaluated across six core competency domains including advanced cooking, food safety, baking, nutrition, financial operations, and personnel management to demonstrate professional excellence in the kitchen environment.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review all recommended reference materials and complete the required education courses covering nutrition, food safety, cost control, beverage management, and supervisory management. Practice multiple-choice questions regularly and ensure all work history and documentation are ready for initial application approval. Candidates should dedicate significant time to mastering the specific technical requirements outlined in the official candidate handbook to ensure readiness for the 100 question exam.
editorial.who_should_take: Culinarians with extensive work experience as a Chef de Cuisine, Executive Sous Chef, Pastry Chef, or chef in charge of food production supervising a team of full-time employees in a professional kitchen.
